entities.name: Dekha Ibrahim Abdi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dekha Ibrahim Abdi was a Kenyan peace activist based in Mombasa, Kenya. She worked as a consultant to government and civil society organisations. She was of Somali ethnicity.
